## Feature Description
Explain what you would like to have added. Can also be an inconvenience/feature you would like to have changed.

## Solution Description
Suggestions on how this feature should be implemented or a clear and concise description of how you want to change the existing feature.

## Additional context
Add any other context, screenshots or sketches of the feature request here.
